answer.explanation: Live configuration matches the IaC template for all four functions (MemorySize, Timeout, environment variables; no reserved concurrency in either). Every invocation in the window completed with a REPORT line and no errors, AccessDenied, timeout or memory-exhaustion messages. Durations stayed well under the timeouts (Compression about 0.5 s against 60 s; Thumbnailer about 0.1 s against 30 s), and max memory used was about 95-110 MB against limits of 256 MB and 1024 MB. The only non-REPORT lines were two INIT_START entries (Thumbnailer, Compression), which are normal cold starts. The Thumbnailer and Compression configurations were last modified at 01:56 and 00:39 UTC, before the window, and the live state still matches the template.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >
  Benchmark application for the thesis "Cross-Layer Context for LLM-Based Detection and
  Root-Cause Analysis of Configuration Anomalies in AWS Lambda". Four SeBS functions
  (Table 3.2). This template is the intended state of the application.

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Architectures: [x86_64]
    Tracing: PassThrough
    LoggingConfig:
      LogFormat: Text

Resources:
  # --------

input.query_string: fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message | filter @message like /(?i)(error|exception|accessdenied|not authorized|timeout|task timed out|memory|killed)/ | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50
fields @timestamp, @log, @message | filter @message not like /^REPORT/ and @message not like /^(START|END)/ | stats count(*) as n by @log, substr(@message,0,60) as msg | sort n desc | limit 30
